info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Security Advisory API
info.description: The Security Advisory API provides insights and guidance on security best practices for banking enterprise services. This endpoint allows users to access specific security advisory details based on unique identifiers. Typical consumers include security analysts, compliance teams, and IT professionals looking to enhance security measures within their banking applications. By offering tailored security recommendations, this API plays a crucial role in mitigating risks and ensuring compliance with industry standards.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about a specific security advisory identified by the resource number RES-100045. It provides insights into vulnerabilities, mitigation strategies, and additional resources.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to fetch the security advisory details associated with the specified resource. It is essential to ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema to successfully retrieve the information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested security advisory details.
